display_long_description:
You’re the new intern. Nobody knows you yet. That’s an advantage.

Nova Prime VR is the kind of place where careers are made fast—and trust is lost even faster. You have one shot to figure out who matters and what you’re willing to do about it.

Dreams & Desires is a live-action interactive story shot with real actors in real locations. Every scene is 360°—wear your headset and stand inside the room. The story doesn’t change. The feeling does.

# What Makes It Different:

– Real actors, practical sets—not animation, not motion capture
– Every location in full 360°—the whole room exists
– Branching dialogue with real stakes—choices close doors
– Built for replay—second runs reveal scenes you couldn’t reach before
– Built from the ground up for VR—not adapted for it

[media]

# Four people. One internship. No easy answers.

Lily: In your corner since day one. Quiet, steady, paying more attention than you realize.
[media]

Stacy: Works the bar downstairs. Fast with a comeback, slow to trust.
[media]

Jessica: Runs the office like she’s seen every version of you. Hard to impress.
[media]

Kate: She trains like every second counts. No patience for half-efforts.
[media]

# Every Choice Costs Something
Conversations branch as you go. Say the wrong thing and you lose someone you need. Your career and your relationships feel separate—until one starts wrecking the other. Four possible endings: career, romance, both, or neither. Each one is earned, not given.
[media]
